Which of the following could be the function that generates the vector field above?
worked_solution:
We notice the following:

- The horizontal component (i.e., the $i$ component) is zero for *every* vector in our vector field. Therefore, we can rule out the following options:

$$
G(x,y)=-i+2\,j,\,H(x,y)=x\,i-y\,j
$$

- As we move away from the origin in the vertical direction, our vectors' vertical components (i.e., the $j$ components) get longer. Therefore, we can rule out the following option:

$$
K(x,y)=-2\,j
$$

Therefore, we conclude that the diagram corresponds to the vector field $F(x,y)=-y\,j.$
